resources.string: NoteNext is 100% free, open-source, and has zero ads. Your support helps me keep it that way and motivates me to build even better features!
Built by a single developer who cares about your experience, not by a corporation.
No ads, no tracking, no selling your data. Ever. Your notes stay private on your device.
Your contribution fuels new features, bug fixes, and regular updates to make NoteNext better.
Your support means the world! ❤️\nNoteNext will keep growing because of amazing people like you.
